en: Are you a farmer?
Yup! I take care o' this small patch of earth, growin' some veggies and whatnot.
Not as talented but a lot more hardworking than them Rada folk, of that you can be sure.
What do you have against the Rada?
It's not that I have somethin' against them. It's that they don't help themselves. I reckon they do a lot o' good for the community... When they're workin'.
Public meetings! Daily reports! Internal discussions! Holy cow do those people like yappin'!
So you own this land?
Not quite, not quite. It's the Church's. I'm an Acolyte, so I gets to use it. Other Acolytes say they prefer other types of work... Indoor stuff, regular charity stuff.
Me, I have all this land all to meself and can work it how I please! That's the dream! Long as the harvest's decent, o'course.
Sounds like you got it good.
Ha! That I do, that I do! It's back-breakin' work, but it pays off.
And the feelin' you get when ya get to feed all 'em folks around ya – nuthin' like it!
Sounds like you got the short end of the stick.
Whaddaya mean? It's back-breakin' work, sure, but it's gratifying. Out the doors. Ain't got my nose stuck in some book like the preachers, don't have ta patch up the wounded somethin' gruesome.
Wouldn't be terrible to have a helping hand, especially when Alexei can't care for Vera 'n' Zoran... But nah, I ain't complainin'.
Fertile land?
Yup, I grows some crops, take care of the whole cycle.
It's good for Zalesye, see. I make stuff to feed the Acolytes, sure, but there's always somethin' left to trade or donate to Commonfolk.
Mechanists come by every now and then to make sure it ain't too radiated and has no Mist! It's all healthy, hundred percent!
You mentioned Acolytes and chastity.
Oh, that's a difficult subject, I ain't super knowledgeable... But yea, Acolytes like us, I guess there's religious reasons to avoid, uhhh, carnal matters.
Might be I'm a blasphemer for sayin' this but uh... I reckon that's just like, a spiritual excuse for people to please, for the sake of the Lord, not give us another mouth to feed.
That's just a guess tho. Please don't tell Alexei I said that.
Vera and Zoran?
Have you met 'em? Jus' the loveliest angels you'll ever see! Rare to see such young folk in this cursed place...
They're twins, an' they's both bedridden from Mist exposure – least that's what I reckon – so I help take care of 'em.
Tell me more about them.
Sure thing!
About something else.
You're not really religious, are you?
Well, I mean... For me, this Church thing, that's a means to an end, ya know? Whether or not there's a God, and a Jesus... I reckon it's just a good way for people to get together.
Work for each other's sake and not just their own navels. Know what I mean?
Tell me about Vera and Zoran.
Whatcha wanna know?
I've got to leave.
You said something about "Mist exposure"?

Well, that's how Alexei done explained it. I ain't medically trained or nothin'. But seems to me they's got so much Mist in those noggins, they got corrupted from the inside. Sometimes they see things and start talkin' all weird.
Ya know – I wish I could talk to a Mudlark 'bout this. Surely they know a lot more than folks like us! 'Cept they can't really *talk* like we do...
I know a Mudlark who can talk. Ilya.
Oh, really now! Ain't that somethin'... I gotta go find this Ilya, then. Maybe she'll pass through these parts sometime...
Would be nice to ask her 'bout the twins... And o' course, maybe if she's real nice, they could meet 'er...
Alexei's not at the Hospital right now.
Holy – since when? The Twins is alone? Damn, I've been here a while... Shit. Gotta hurry on back...

Just hav'ta finish up here right quick, go check on 'em... Head back, get those tools, can't forget... Ask scavenger for more tools, talk 'bout crops with Church, then food for the Twins. Get 'em changed... Maybe tomorrow... Need to till here... Water that spot... Have to...
Not many young people here in Zalesye.
You're tellin' me! Those angels, dear Vera and Zoran, they's the only ones I gets to talk to on the regular.
I guess, well, I ain't no expert, but this ain't exactly the kinda world makes folks wanna bone.

... Sorry I said bone, that's not becomin' of an Acolyte. I meant, y'know. Carnal... Carnal stuff. Welp, I s'pose there's another culprit of the whole "no younglings" thing – us Acolytes and our talk of chastity.
I don't know. Explain it to me.
Quit pullin' my leg, now, Vulture. I know y'all not as dumb as y'all act!
It's OK, I don't mind.
Thanks chum. Don't tell Alexei I said that word. He's always on my ass 'bout language.
Talking about something else...
I need to go, now.
How do ya do, fella.
Howdy there!
How's it goin', Vulture.
Can we talk?
We should talk.
Got some questions.
Have anything to trade for?
Got any food worth trading?
I want to trade.
I have some extra produce, sure.
Anythin' not goin' to the Acolytes, ye can trade for.
Welp, I'm more about donatin', but let's do this.
Sure, let's trade some.
Catch ya later, Vulture.
Sorry I'm too busy for a proper chat.
Drop by again, chum.
Alright, later.
I'll get those supplies, yeah.
Yer a lifesaver! Let me know when you do!
Gotta think about it first.
S'pose it ain't much of a rush.
Rather take a different request – got anything?
I'll come by later for more work.
Thanks and take care.
I'll go exterminate them.
That's what I like to hear.
Let me think about it.
Well, sure, but... Sooner'd be better, rather than later...
Not up for it – got anything else?
Wasn't a big deal. Take care.
Glad I could help.
You need help with something?
I need work. Got anything?
Something I can help you with?
Been runnin’ outta some basic things what you’ll find 'round here… Appreciate some help. Reward in it for ya. Whaddaya say?
I need some supplies to keep these crops goin’. Can reward you if you get some for me. You up for it?
Thanks a bunch, Vulture! That'll be a big help. Here's your reward.
I see you got everything I asked for! Here's your compensation.
Oh, nice – everything I needed! Here's your pay.
Me and some other Acolytes been havin’ plenty o’ trouble from those mutated critters. Bunch of ‘em are messing up the plantations… Help us get rid of ‘em, Vulture.
There’s been more than a lil’ bit of trouble lately – Mutants runnin’ in packs, attackin’ our crops. Would ya mind getting rid of 'em for us?
Got them all, huh? That's fantastic. Here, as I promised.
Nice – and you're in one piece, too. Here you go.
Fantastic! I'll let the other Acolytes know. Here's your reward.
I don't have any more requests for the time bein'.
Don't really need anythin' else right now.

Actin' like they know enough 'bout agriculture to lecture me... Then I gets to Dubravka and it's all "let's have more meetings!!"...

Plus the feelin' when ya get to feed folks around ya – nuthin' like it! Just as sweet as carin' for sweet lil' Vera n' Zoran.

Might be just the case that it's still a little fertile despite everything... We's just usin' the knowledge what we learned from our forefolk.

Need a Vulture?
Got a special request?
I need a Vulture now, yeah. Been waitin' on a supply drop to keep things movin' down th'farms... Church's usually on time with that stuff...
Then my Sisters told me the delivery girl straight-up vanished! I need those supplies, Vulture, and it'd be good to make sure the girl's safe. D'you mind searching around for me?
I'll see what I can do.
That's great to hear, mister. Here's hopin' ya find both the supplies 'n that poor lil' Acolyte! Won't do to just wait around...
Girl's probably dead. No use searching.
... Kid. I know what the worst case scenario is. Been through it before. I'm just askin' ya to let me have a lil' hope. Ok? It's a simple gig.
... Fine. I'll do it.
Thank you, Vulture. Hopin' you can bring some good news. But I'll give ya a reward, even if you don't.
Not wasting my time on this.
... I'll be charitable and assume that ruckus up there done made you a bit more cautious than usual. Come talk again when you're back in business.
What's the route these supply drops take?
Can't really tell ya... Church's got a pretty lil' garden right next to it, where they's always growin' somethin'. Might be some o' my supplies came from over there.
Also, they get Palatines 'n Vultures actin' as bodyguards... Well, probably just Palatines now that the number o' Vultures done dwindled a bit.
So the carrier was an Acolyte?
That's right... Dunno her personally, just heard she's a lady, bit young maybe. S'pose she'd stand out a bit from her surroundings... Wait, that might be a bad thing...
I'm gonna get to it.
Alrighty, best of luck to ya.
About those missing supplies.
Jasna. Here to report.
About the job.
Welp, what is it, mister? Got my treasure?
Found this. (Hand over Church Supplies.)
Well I'll be damned! Was honestly thinkin' these woulda been long gone already... Good job, Vulture. This'll make the next weeks a lot easier...
But... Don't tell me... That girl? Kinda lookin' like you ain't exactly found and led her to safety...
She didn't make it.
Oh, God... Poor thing. Didn't even have a chance to meet 'er. Life 'round here sure is tough sometimes...
Would she be alive if I hadn't yelled at the Church for help? Managed on my own?... Actin' like a spoiled brat... Wantin' a break... Shit... I can't...
Got shredded by Bandits.
Christ, Vulture, that's terrible... Here I was hopin' for the best but nah, good ol' Zalesye reminds us what a hellscape it is...
I mean, I just ask for supplies, don't even know who they sendin', suddenly this young girl's up n' dying... If I hadn't been so lazy...
Searched everywhere. Nothing. (Keep Church Supplies.)
Dammit, tsk. This gon' make my next few weeks a hell of a lot tougher. Plus next time Vera 'n Zoran need somethin', I'm not sure I'll trust the Church to...
Wait... You didn't find the supplies, but... What about the Acolyte bringing 'em over? My Sister Acolyte...?
Bandits ambushed me near the Church. Her corpse was nearby.
Christ... Well if yer here to tell the tale, 'least ya gave those sorry fucks the what-for... Not that it matters much in this land...
Anyways, Vulture. You deserve a lil' compensation, it's just... 'Fraid I can't spare much, knowing how fucked I am now...
Bandits gunned her down and escaped.
God... Not even a tiny lil' taste o' that "divine retribution", huh? Startin' to think it's all sum' quackery...
But that don't mean ya don't deserve yer reward, o' course. Just... Not tryin' to swindle ya, but I just found out I'm in trouble here...

Guess they're all too mutated to talk after all...
